_comment: Soldier portraits (R6): three types (columns: villager=peasant, mercenary, gladiator) by three looks (rows: rough, fine, gilded). Each card is cut 1 px inside the dark line within its gold frame (measured with probe: the painting runs x 32-290, 340-599, 649-908), 22 px below the inner top edge so no chamfered corner of the frame is in the crop, and drawn down to the size its window uses (SLICING_GUIDE: paint big, draw down). Which tiers wear which look: client/scripts/ui/soldier_art.gd.

crops.name: portraits/soldier_peasant_rough
crops.note: peasant (rough): the card's head-and-chest, below the chamfered corners, drawn down 0.51 into the strip card's portrait window

crops.name: portraits/soldier_peasant_rough_large
crops.note: peasant (rough): the same framing taller, drawn down 0.78 into the selected soldier's window under army/sel_frame
